visibility_definitions.VISIBLE: The decisive owner-side algorithm/conditions or standard API operation are visible. This is static source inspection; imported/callee runtime correctness is not proved. Supplemental source context is cited where it confirms a binding, without claiming that context entered the input.
visibility_definitions.PARTIAL: Some requested operations/conditions are visible but a decisive clause requires an omitted lexical child, owner passage or custom helper/binding/fixture outside the card. A visible invocation is recorded as delegation, not silently treated as the full hidden implementation.
visibility_definitions.ABSENT: The decisive assertions/implementation asked for are absent from the actual card. A relevant name/docstring may remain; this status concerns those operations, not the literal absence of all related text.

conclusions: All26 correct cards fit the original only_second512 encoding in full:123–471 pair tokens. None of these26 failures is explained by tokenizer prefix truncation.

Four selected queries lose material source logic before tokenization through child ownership or card passage selection. The loss is observed information availability, not proof that it caused their final rank.
Nine partial cases need off-card custom helper/binding/fixture context for a full literal reading. They are distinct from tokenizer truncation and from a confirmed wrong reference.
The remaining13 show the core requested operations in the input and still lose to another owner. Visibility alone therefore does not establish the model ranking cause.
All26 references remain source-grounded on this reading. No labels, acceptable identities, source ranges or denominator were altered; no exhaustive search for additional alternatives was undertaken.
scope_limits: This is an error-conditioned review of26/200 exposed development queries;5 missing-top10 queries were counted but not inspected. It does not estimate a population error rate or acceptance quality.

The frozen original card source and tokenizer were used. Source-syntax162 supplies original unit order and captured expanded queries; its syntax-enhanced texts were not substituted for original card_text.
Operation visibility is diagnostic only, not a new acceptance gate and not historical ALL-anchors scoring. Source witness ranges provide rationale rather than a mandatory exact snippet.
No model weights, ONNX session, A186 outputs, private acceptance labels or reserve payloads were opened. No inference, fit, engine benchmark, producer edit or per-ID improvement was performed.
The audit cannot prove which available tokens a trained model used; it offers no causal certification and does not change the fixed A186 recipe.

def _format_lines(lines: Sequence[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Format the individual lines.

    This will replace the '{', '}' and '~' characters of our mini formatting
    language with the proper 'where ...', 'and ...' and ' + ...' text, taking
    care of indentation along the way.

    Return a list of formatted lines.
    """
implementation _format_lines lines 82-105:
    result = list(lines[:1])
    stack = [0]
    stackcnt = [0]
    for line in lines[1:]:
        if line.startswith("{"):
            if stackcnt[-1]:
                s = "and   "
            else:
                s = "where "
            stack.append(len(result))
            stackcnt[-1] += 1
            stackcnt.append(0)
            result.append(" +" + "  " * (len(stack) - 1) + s + line[1:])
        elif line.startswith("}"):
            stack.pop()
            stackcnt.pop()
            result[stack[-1]] += line[1:]
        else:
            assert line[0] in ["~", ">"]
            stack[-1] += 1
            indent = len(stack) if line.startswith("~") else len(stack) - 1
            result.append("  " * indent + line[1:])
    assert len(stack) == 1
    return result
